result_callbacks.name: Verifies that fragment navigation reveals hidden=until-found elements.
Verifies that fragment navigation reveals all parent hidden=until-found elements.
Verifies that the beforematch event is fired synchronously and bubbles after fragment navigation.
result_callbacks.message: assert_true: beforematch should have been fired on parentid. expected true got false

result_callbacks.name: Verifies that when a beforematch event handler moves a matching element, we scroll to its final location.
result_callbacks.message: assert_true: The beforematch event should have been fired. expected true got false

result_callbacks.name: Verifies that the beforematch event is fired on the right element when there are multiple hidden=until-found elements.
result_callbacks.message: assert_true: bar was navigated to, so it should get the beforematch event. expected true got false

result_callbacks.name: Verifies that no scrolling occurs when an element selected by the fragment identifier is detached by the beforematch event handler.
result_callbacks.message: assert_true: beforematch should be called when window.location.hash is set to #detach. expected true got false

result_callbacks.name: No scrolling should occur when the beforematch event handler sets the target element's style to display: none.
Scrolling should still occur when beforematch sets visiblity:hidden on the target element.
result_callbacks.message: assert_true: The page should be scrolled down to where #visibilityhidden is. expected true got false

result_callbacks.name: Verifies that the beforematch event is not fired on elements without hidden=until-found.
The hidden attribute should still be set inside the beforematch event handler.
